title: Dinosaurs may have been eating seaweed 100 million years ago
caption:
Chemical analysis of fossil tooth enamel reveals that dinosaurs along prehistoric coastlines were eating marine seaweed. Storms washed ocean vegetation ashore, fueling a coastal food web that sustained both giant herbivores and predators.

Source: Sciencedaily - Dinosaurs may have been eating seaweed 100 million years ago

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261112230502.htm
